verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents AI Gateway's proxy features: caching, rate limiting, fallbacks, dynamic routing flows and logging. Nothing in it describes scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. Dynamic routing 'flows' are per-request routing logic, not scheduled runs, and rate-limit time windows are an adjacent control, not a recurring schedule, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
